findings.F1: The tested effect is zero rather than weak. On the cases step 5 counted, the short-direction unusual 7-day move is -0.09 % (t -0.09, 209 cases on 168 days), 0.001 of a usual move. On the shown folds B and C it is -0.84 % (t -0.56, 83 cases).
findings.F2: The grading runs the wrong way at every horizon. The larger half of |forecast| minus the smaller half is -1.88 % at 7 days (step 5), and on folds B and C it is -0.92 % at 3 days, -1.87 % at 7 days and -7.03 % at 14 days.
findings.F3: Another horizon does not rescue it. The short-direction unusual move on folds B and C is -0.36 % at 3 days (t -0.43, 106 cases), -0.84 % at 7 days (t -0.56, 83) and -2.21 % at 14 days (t -0.88, 62), all on the side against the idea.
findings.F4: The result is mixed and has no stable sign by period or coin.
findings.F5: Where profile cells did fall further after a falling week, it was the market's own decline, not continuation. In the choppy-agitated grid cells after a 7-day fall, the next 7 days were -10.7 % unusual (t -3.36, 18 cells). But cells after a 7-day rise also fell, -4.8 % (t -3.05, 12 cells). The falls came from 2020 and 2021 (-21.5 % and -12.9 %), while 2019 was +0.04 %.
findings.F6: Outside the profile the weekly move does carry on, but only on the rise side and weakly. Over all 7-day grid cells, a scaled 7-day rise above 1.5 usual moves was followed by +4.3 % unusual (t 2.13, 93 cells). A scaled fall below -1.5 was followed by only -1.4 % (t -0.59, 37 cells). Inside the profile the rank correlation was 0.13, against 0.04 outside it. This is general weekly momentum, a situation other than the brief's choppy-agitated one, and it is not the tested fall side.

no_ideas: The theme's effect is not in the data. The fall continuation in a choppy, agitated market is zero (F1), its grading is reversed at every horizon (F2, F3), and its sign flips by window, year and coin (F4). Its only apparent strength is the market's own falls in two years (F5), so no narrower case of the theme's situation shows the effect.
